tool.name: TradingVPS
tool.description: TradingVPS offers Ryzen-based servers for trading platforms, with Windows Server or Ubuntu. Data centers listed include Chicago, New York, London, Frankfurt, Amsterdam and Dublin.
features: AMD Ryzen 9 CPU, DDR5 memory and NVMe storage
A dedicated IPv4 address on each listed plan
Remote desktop from a computer or phone

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: 1 core, 4 GB RAM, 100 GB. Suggested for 1 chart.

plans.name: Basic
plans.detail: 2 cores, 8 GB RAM, 200 GB. Suggested for 1 to 2 charts.

plans.name: Standard
plans.detail: 4 cores, 16 GB RAM, 300 GB. Suggested for 2 to 4 charts.

plans.name: Professional
plans.detail: 6 cores, 24 GB RAM, 400 GB. Suggested for 3 to 6 charts.

plans.name: Expert
plans.detail: 8 cores, 32 GB RAM, 500 GB. Suggested for 5 to 8 charts.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.detail: 16 cores, 64 GB RAM, 600 GB. Suggested for 8 or more charts.

tool.pricing_note: The first monthly prices on the official homepage on 11 Oct 2026. The same page also showed lower monthly amounts that were not clearly tied to a billing period.
